description: Get SaaS-enabled locations for a CRM company, optionally filtered by customer or subscription.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

customerId.description: Stripe customer ID to filter by

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

subscriptionId.description: Stripe subscription ID to filter by

name: crm_saas_get_locations
